plan.notes: Source: official Barton CC degree map 'Paramedic, Associate in Applied Science - 68 Credit Hours' (Review Date: 09/25, Effective Date: 08/25; no catalog-year label, stamped retrieval year 2026-2027). Sequenced TERM 1-5 as printed; term totals 16/12/12/12/16 = 68 reconcile exactly. Note: the map assigns 4 sh to the Term 1 A&P group ('LIFE 1408 or LIFE 1407 or LIFE 1411'); transcribed as printed. Certified Kansas EMT is an admission milestone, not a course; NREMT Paramedic exam eligibility is a milestone.
